title: Activation Pathfinder — KPI Lab Notes & Launch Canvas
content:
Purpose: quick, tactical lab for validating the smallest set of signals we need to greenlight a limited activation (pilot or staggered beta). This is intentionally lightweight — a set of micro-experiments + stop/go triggers + KPI surface and owner map so on-call and PMs can act fast.

Key constraints we care about (assumptions):
- Must support predictable latency for 95th pct under pilot traffic (target: 350ms).
- Cost footprint capped for pilot at $X/day (accounting cache hit gains).
- Quality: no >3% semantic regression vs baseline prompts on sampled eval set.
- Able to rollback within 5 minutes via traffic fencing.

1) Activation slices (mini cohorts) — priority order
- Slice A (internal pilot): 50 internal users, 0.5 RPS average, deep instrumentation.
- Slice B (beta customers): 200 users, 2 RPS average, real prompt mix, limited features.
- Slice C (open): staged rollout after Slice B pass, 5–10 RPS burst capacity.

2) Micro-experiment matrix (what to run in first 72 hours)
- Latency probe (synthetic): 95th latency, p50, p99, token throughput. Owner: Ethan Park. Metric query: APM -> traces named "gen_v1" filtered by model=redwood-curie-quant.
- Cost probe (batching sensitivity): effective tokens / $ by batch_size=[1,4,16]. Owner: Priya. Data: billing-exports sample.
- Quality drift check (prompt set): top-30 critical prompts, BLEU-ish + human-review flags. Owner: Marisol. Alert if >3% failures.
- KV cache hit rate test: prefix reuse synthetic workload to validate >20% saving. Owner: Liam.
- Fallback correctness: simulate model variant fallback 100x, ensure response shape preserved. Owner: Ethan.

3) KPI definitions (single-line canonical signals we will watch)
- SLO_LAT_95: 95th percentile request latency (ms) — SLO trigger: >350ms sustained 10m.
- SLO_ERROR_RATE: user-visible error rate (5xx + timeouts) — Alert: >0.5% sustained 10m.
- KPI_COST_PER_1k: cost per 1k tokens served — target: <$Y.
- KPI_QUALITY_FAIL_RATE: % prompts failing quality checks — trigger: >3% across sample.
- KPI_CACHE_HIT: prefix/KV cache hit rate — target: >=20%.
- KPI_THROUGHPUT_RT: generated tokens/sec under pilot concurrency — used for capacity safety.

4) Stop / Rollforward triggers (automated + manual)
- Automated immediate rollback if SLO_ERROR_RATE > 1.5% OR SLO_LAT_95 > 500ms for 5m.
- Manual hold if KPI_QUALITY_FAIL_RATE between 3% and 5% — requires PM + SRE review.
- Graduated rollforward allowed when: SLO_LAT_95 < 300ms, KPI_COST_PER_1k within target, KPI_QUALITY_FAIL_RATE < 1.5% for 24h.

5) Dashboards & queries (minimum view set to build)
- Pilot Overview: latency histogram, errors by route, traffic by slice, rollout fraction timeline.
- Experiment Matrix: small table of batch_size vs cost_per_1k vs mean latency.
- Quality Sampling: live sample viewer of model outputs for the prompt set (random 1/100).
- Fallback Exercise Log: manual runs and outcomes, last successful / failed.

6) Owner RACI (short)
- Marisol Vega (R): product-ops lead, owns readiness decision and quality signoff.
- Ethan Park (R): SRE/observability, config for probes and rollback plumbing.
- Priya Nair (A): growth/product PM for pilot customers + telemetry.
- Liam O'Connor (C): applied-ml for model variant tuning, quant profile advice.
- Infra Eng oncall (I): implements fencing and traffic-split ops.

7) Quick checklist (pre-activation, <8 items)
- [ ] Canary route created + healthy (smoke tests passing).
- [ ] Rollback playbook posted in #oncall with runbook links.
- [ ] APM traces show synthetic baseline runs for last 24h.
- [ ] Billing sampling enabled for cost probes.
- [ ] Eval prompts uploaded and sampling pipeline checked.
- [ ] KV cache metrics wired and sample logs validated.
- [ ] Team on-call and PM on standby for first 2 hours.
- [ ] Customer communication template drafted for Slice B.

8) Mini-sprint cadence for runway (timeline in rough days)
- Day -3: final smoke runs, config lock, pre-warm caches.
- Day 0: start Slice A (internal), run latency + cost micro-experiments.
- Day 1–2: evaluate signals, fix regression, iterate quant / batching.
- Day 3: open Slice B if green; monitor quality cadence.
- Day 4–7: hold window for stability; expand if pass.

9) Known risks + mitigations (one-line)
- Risk: regression in hallucination patterns post-quantization. Mitigation: conservative quant profile + increased manual sampling.
- Risk: cold-cache spikes on first-hour traffic. Mitigation: prewarm scripts + synthetic ramp.
- Risk: cost overshoot if batching ineffective. Mitigation: limit feature flags and configure autoscale caps.

10) Notes / open questions to resolve before final signoff
- What is final gating threshold for partial feature set (function-calling vs plain text)? (Owner: Priya)
- Is HSM key rotation required for Private pilot? (Owner: Security team — link in Confluence).
- Confirm SLO alert routing to PagerDuty escalation policy 'prodops-pilot'. (Owner: Ethan)

Appendix (quick links):
- Confluence plan: CONFLUENCE-PLAN-7682
- Jira epic: PRODOPS-9123
- Checklist template: /templates/launch-checklist-mini.csv

Bottom line: this canvas is intentionally pragmatic — run small, learn fast, and keep the stop conditions explicit. Use it as the authoritative micro-runbook for the first activation window and iterate into the full launch playbook when signals and owners converge.
